old_caption: The video captures a fire burning in a fire pit on an outdoor patio. Bright orange flames flicker and rise from burning material, including what appears to be charcoal briquettes and charred paper or leaves. A large, dark, porous block, possibly a firebrick, sits in the pit, with the flames actively consuming material around and on it. A white cylindrical object, resembling a coffee pod or similar container, rests near the bottom center. The background shows a white picket fence, a house with green siding, and a swing hanging from a tree. The ground around the pit is covered in ash and charred debris. The camera remains stationary throughout, focusing on the fire pit and its immediate surroundings. The scene is calm, with no people or animals visible, and the only movement is from the flames and the gradual consumption of the burning materials.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a serene outdoor scene centered around a fire pit situated on a patio. The fire pit is filled with burning wood and paper, producing bright orange flames that flicker vigorously. The surrounding area includes a white picket fence, a swing hanging from a tree, and a glimpse of a house with green siding. The ground around the fire pit is covered with ash and charred remnants of the burning materials. A white cylindrical object, possibly a container or a piece of equipment, is partially visible near the bottom center of the frame. The background remains static throughout the video, emphasizing the dynamic movement of the flames and the gradual consumption of the wood and paper by the fire. There are no animals or people present in the scene, and the camera maintains a steady position, focusing on the fire pit and its immediate surroundings. The overall atmosphere is calm and quiet, with the only sound being the crackling of the fire.
caption: The video captures a close view of a round metal fire pit in a backyard, with a white picket fence, pale house, and hanging tire swing in the background. Several dark, dome-shaped charred pieces rest on a grey concrete block at the center, while crumpled black paper lies to the right, white ash to the left, and a labeled white roll sits in the foreground. Bright orange-yellow flames rise continuously from the charred pieces throughout the clip, already burning at the first frame. The flames flicker constantly, repeatedly changing height, width, and shape, surging into tall vertical tongues at some moments and collapsing into shorter, right-leaning licks at others. The brightness and extent of the burning on the charred pieces vary frame by frame as the fire surges and recedes. Thin wisps of smoke appear intermittently above the flames near the top edge. The charred pieces, block, roll, paper pile, ash, and background fence, house, and swing all remain fixed, with no object translation or deformation. The camera stays static, and the fire is still burning as the clip ends.

Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
The caption itself must directly describe the video: no mention of annotation, images, sampling,
timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
